symptoms: Dyspnoea, orthopnoea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea, peripheral oedema
POCUS findings: >3 B-lines per zone, pleural/pericardial effusions, dilated non-collapsible IVC

management_steps.details: Nitrocine (Nitroglycerin): 1-2 mg IV boluses OR Infusion at 30 ug/min (titrate up to max 150-200 ug/min). Non-Invasive Ventilation (NIV - CPAP or BiPAP).
Furosemide (Lasix): Give patient's total daily oral dose as IV bolus, or start at 20-40mg IV STAT.
Cardiogenic shock: Dobutamine infusion. Hypotension: Crystalloid fluid bolus 10-20mg/kg [printed as mg/kg in source document].

warnings: Source prints fluid bolus units as '10-20mg/kg' instead of ml/kg (flagged in errata).
